title: A collection built from offsets the caller supplies
body:
An mmseqs database frames its records with a null byte. Their offsets live in a separate .index file. The data is split across pdb.0 to pdb.N. Scanning for a delimiter is the wrong primitive for it. Delimit does not fit.

Index::new(format, offsets) holds offsets a caller parsed out of the .index file. The numeric key could serve as the name. With Framed in place the constructor already exists: Framed::with_index(path, Index::new(format, offsets)). Two decisions remain:

1. How a .saidx tags a format libsail does not know. The header holds one format byte and the reader rejects any other value.
2. Whether split data files get a concatenating Source, or whether the caller is told to pass one file at a time.

The same two decisions cover a consumer-supplied Delimit. Raised while shaping sail-88cc19 and left out of it on purpose. nail's plan uses libsail's FASTA and p7hmm delimiters and nothing else.
